combinations.magnitude: H-20 raised threshold in WT but had no effect in Pd1 KO (P > 0.05)
combinations.evidence_quote: As shown in Fig. 1H, preemptive i.t. injection of H-20 (30 nmol) significantly increased the basal mechanical threshold in naïve WT mice (onset of 30 min, duration of at least 150 min), but evidently had no effect on naïve Pd1 knockout mice (P > 0.05).
